name: Bean Sprouts
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as the sprouting process reduces FODMAP content compared to whole beans. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before use and consume fresh for best digestibility
Lightly cook rather than eating raw if you have sensitive digestion
Add to stir-fries in the last few minutes to maintain crunch
Store in refrigerator and use within 2-3 days of purchase
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and folate
